notes.title: ATONE: Heart of the Elder Tree joins Untold Tales
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Three years ago, we launched our first ever title as a studio with ATONE: Heart of the Elder Tree. It was received with critical acclaim and won several awards, and we were so humbled by all the support and love for the unique Norse world we created.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41232016/4005a0aa7ce0f645ef6de4804fc79f41f34448ac.png

Now, we have several announcements to share with you all! 

New Publisher
First up, we're happy to share that we have an official publisher: Untold Tales! They've been a great partner and will support us in all efforts to bring our game to you as smoothly as possible. So go on and give them a follow! -> 

Release Window
Second, we're excited to confirm that we're targeting launch in early 2023. We understand that it's not an exact date, but game development can fluctuate wildly and we don't want to promise something only to disappoint! AND, we'll also be launching on Nintendo Switch, so you can find us there if that's more your style.

Next Fest Demo Available Now
Last but certainly not least, we have a free demo for you to try as part of Next Fest! That's right, it's available now. So keep that axe sharp, you'll need it! And when you're done playing, come back and give us your thoughts. We'd love to hear them!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/894620

If you enjoyed what you played, please wishlist and spread the word, as that helps immensely to increase awareness. Be sure to follow our social channels below for all news and future updates on ATONE.

Twitter: https://twitter.com/UntoldTalesHQ
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/untoldtalesgames
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@untoldtaleshq

Cheers!
Wildboy Studios and Untold Tales

notes.title: October Update is Out!
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for playing Lifeslide and being part of the community! Before we start, if you have been following the game but you don't have it yet, Lifeslide is 30% off until November 1st so now is a great time to jump aboard:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/956140/Lifeslide/

What's new?
This month's update comes a bit late but there is a good reason for that. We have added a bunch of new content and features. And without further ado:

New Level Content
We have extended some of the levels with additional segments meaning that there are now new places to explore! The extended levels are Loving, Giving and Softening.
                       https://media.giphy.com/media/kuoaMUyfMVvXF4zdJT/giphy.gif

New Hidden Skins To Unlock
The appearances department was a bit lacking so we have been working to create some good looking skins that you can unlock. Explore hidden areas to unlock the new appearances. Most of them are visible in the Appearances menu and have hints. There are also three secret skins. We won't tell you where they are. 
                                                   {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33779834/4e84a12ae49523b1c9e21cb4aca31ab634cbc9cb.gif

Speedrun Mode
New Speedrun mode has been added for those of you who like to race against the clock. Supported modes are New Game and New Game +. Leaderboards hold the best results - the competition is on! You can find Speedrun Mode in Main Menu / Compete

Halloween Fest Event Ready to Start
The Halloween Fest event starts on October 31st and ends on November 7th. Learn more here.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33779834/c1c11385ee9b95dcca79fd1fdc7bb521e6dd9e41.png

Other Changes & Fixes

 The weekly challenge updates - maps are a bit shorter, players receive damage from environment, values are balanced
 The green plane stats have been tweaked
 Fixed tiny gaps between segments on some levels
 Fixed gaps between segments on some levels
 Fixed the challenge countdown timer sound not being affected by the SFX slider
 Fixed the bug where players can start the game with a Will power-up
 Paper skins now look sharper in-game


That's it for October's update we hope you have fun exploring the new content and now it's time for:

What's next?
We'll skip November but we are already working on more content for a December update. You can expect a very special Christmas event, more level extensions, more appearances and possibly modding support.

notes.title: September Update is Out!
notes.content:
Lifeslide September Update is Live!
Thank you for playing this weird little game! It means a lot to us.
Our team has been working hard to improve the Lifeslide experience and patch any holes in the hull along the way. Now, without further ado, let's dig into what's new:

Player Ghosts
[previewyoutube=1S3EYUBbvAI;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]
We are working to expand and improve the weekly challenges. This is why you can now see the players above you in the leaderboards right next to you while flying. There is a setting for how many player ghosts you like to see inside the options menu. Player ghosts can also be turned off from the options menu. Check out this video to see how this looks in-game.

Save File Management
One of the more common questions we've been getting in our community is how to delete save files. Worry not, we got you! You can now create up to three save files and delete existing ones. Find the Manage Saves screen in Options/Game/Manage Saves {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33779834/77c4774f1e9c25c180b25c447e61a2cdbfb35eec.png

Flight Stick & Generic Controller Support 
We have added support for flight sticks and generic controllers. Lifeslide is now playable with HOTAS controllers, racing wheels (yes, not recommended) and generic controllers. For some specific generic controllers, the UI might not be navigatable but the input can be set up in the Bindings screen of the controls options. 

Reset Tutorials Button
If you need to reset the tutorials but don't want to start a new game, you can now do that in Options/Game/Reset Tutorials

Bulgarian Localization
We're a Bulgarian studio so we've added Bulgarian language to the game and Steam store page. Наздраве!

Smaller Fixes and Tweaks

 Game start screen added right after the intro
 UI is now more responsive and can be navigated faster
 Fixed issues with missing Russian, Chinese, Japanese and Korean font glyphs
 Better camera behavior when flying close to ceilings
 Better countdown and launch sequence for the weekly challenges
 Plane selection for weekly challenges now shows the player rank for each plane
 Added burning sounds when the player is... well, burning
 Various small tweaks and fixes in the UI and UX


What's next?
This is it for the September update but we're working on more features and content for October. Halloween is upon us and we're preparing something quite special. You can expect more level content and more skins.

We do our best to address all issues mentioned on Discord and in the Steam discussions. 
Got any feature requests or bug reports? Get in touch!
https://steamcommunity.com/app/956140/discussions/
https://discord.gg/bkYDq8v

notes.title: Lifeslide September BETA is Out
notes.content:
Hello everyone and thank you for an exciting August! 
It has been exactly a month since Lifeslide was released here on Steam. During that time we have been working on new content and features because we want to keep expanding and improving the Lifeslide experience. 

Lifeslide September BETA is Out
Content updates are coming soon but until then we would like to introduce some new features in the game. The feature in question is player ghosts in the weekly challenges. You will now be able to see how other players have played through the challenge. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33779834/89681eb52ff207c38bf27212fb1fd573cd8d57d6.png

The feature is still experimental and so we're looking to gather some feedback as well as stress test it. For those of you who would like to help testing this, we would really appreciate it if you jumped on the BETA branch and played some weekly challenges. 

Other changes in the BETA branch so far:

 Better countdown and launch sequence for the challenges
 Better camera behavior when flying close to ceilings
 The UI and navigation is now more responsive to allow for faster retries
 Improved point collection effect to give a better understanding of where the points are coming from


More coming soon!

How to get Lifeslide BETA?
To get the Lifeslide BETA version with all the latest features and additions, right click Lifeslide in your Library, then choose Properties, navigate to the BETAS tab and from the dropdown menu select "beta":
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33779834/8e1a84f129a8da7feb7112836f8e9706cc924c03.png

How to give feedback?
You can give us feedback in the Steam discussions: here
Or you can join our Discord server: here

Thank you for helping us bring new things to the table!

notes.title: Day 1 Patch
notes.content:
Okay, yes, more like day 3 patch but better late than never, right? Oh, no, "Never" is not something you'll get in regards to Lifeslide update - that's a promise!

First of all, thank you all so much for the amazing feedback and support throughout the launch days! Our team is humbled by the positive reception and we want to keep delivering new things to keep everyone smile! 

Change log
Throughout the launch, we spotted a bunch of issues that we wanted to fix right away and so here we go:

Fixed unloading sky textures 
We're so sorry to let this slip upon release. This glitch was caused by looping through the entire game or going to the main menu and returning to the game. It was not game breaking but it was very ugly. The sky is now here to stay!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33779834/4553930f074c4801d2b92b6924088fe5e04472c8.png

Fixed the In Love achievement
The In Love achievement rewards you for passing the "Loving" level without collecting a single Integrity or Matter gem. Or at least it was supposed to. We found out that the achievement was being rewarded to everyone regardless. This is now fixed and now you gotta work for it! 

Fixed Zen Crash
There was a critical issue with one of the levels in Zen mode where it caused the entire game mode to stop working. We have patched it. Zen is now stable! 


Small fixes

 Fixed the description of one of the plane's skins
 Fixed some spawn points on Story that were sketchy
 Fixed plane selection rendering the paper planes gray-ish
 Fixed some animations in the "Creating" level. Giant falling blocks from the sky are no joke!
 Tweaked the mountain ridge before the ending so that it doesn't cause halts
 Reduced the long delay after the ending sequence
 Fixed a graphical glitch where a black thing was flashing on screen every once in a while


Well, that's it for now.

What's next?
We are in dire need of a break and will take this week off to regenerate. We'll be keeping an eye on the community during the break.

After that, well, we have plans for some CONTENT AND FEATURE UDPATES! Yes, new level content, more plane appearances, new music, UI/UX improvements and more is coming in about a month and a half! Stay tuned for this! 

And after that?
Did you know we have multiplayer racing in the works? Yes! If the game does well, we will be able to further develop it:
MULTIPLAYER FOOTAGE

If you haven't yet joined the Discord community - that's the best place to give feedback and discuss the future of Lifeslide: [url=]https://discord.gg/bkYDq8v

notes.title: What the Steam Release of Lifeslide Brings to the Table
notes.content:
Lifeslide started as an Apple Arcade exclusive and is now slowly making its way to Steam. Our team is driven to make the most out of this transition by adding new content, improving gameplay and feel and redesigning existing levels.

Release Announcement and Demo
Lifeslide is coming to Steam this summer, August 6th. We released a demo with the start of E3 for everyone eager to get their hands on the experience early. Demo is available to download on the game's page.

What's Remastered?
A lot! We remade entire levels from scratch with fresh level design and new level art. Experience more exciting moments, an improved difficulty curve and better pacing. Check out how some levels have been recreated at the bottom of the post.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33779834/26687db5fce76ad53e55cc38780d7f2b0431c6ac.gif

New places, pathways, challenges and things to discover!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33779834/f6a3c321e572ef57223a9cb917ae5946c04d2c27.png

New paper planes to unlock!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33779834/201910d81d6d25f93152f17129f71fcf2653addf.png

Different appearances!
You didn't hear this from us but yes, we are also working on skins and hope to make it for the release day.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33779834/d4ae0d216783408a26e3ed6f31d82dbb70fa56e4.png

Weekly challenges!
We are introducing a new game mode. Weekly challenges with leaderboards. Fly as close to objects and surfaces as fast as possible and earn points. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33779834/00ae926f55f0aaf5151d2880f788a8f7e9c05314.png

Refined controls
Controls have been refined and the entire physical experience has been tweaked. Use keyboard, mouse or take advantage of the full controller support.
